metadata.title: Audit Trail and Compliance for All AP Activities

story.asA: As an auditor or chief accountant
story.iWant: I want a complete, filterable history of every AP event and a disaster recovery (DR) plan
story.soThat: so that statutory and business compliance is bulletproof
story.tasks:
1. Backend: Ensure comprehensive audit logging for all AP activities (AC: #1) - Verify all bill operations are logged via AuditService.logPurchaseBillEvent() with before/after snapshots, diff hash, user, timestamp, IP address - Verify all payment operations are logged via AuditService.logPaymentEvent() with complete metadata - Verify all VAT operations are logged (from Story 4.6) with rate override, sum validation failure, ratio blocks, corrections, report generation - Verify all statement operations are logged (from Story 4.5) with generation, export, email, import, reconciliation, dispute updates - Add missing audit logging for any AP operations not yet covered - Ensure all audit entries include company_id for multi-tenancy filtering
2. Backend: Create APAuditService for audit timeline and filtering (AC: #2, #5) - Create APAuditService interface and APAuditServiceImpl - Implement getAuditTimeline(filters) method with support for user, action, amount, supplier, attachment, outcome, date range filters - Implement getAuditEventDetails(eventId) method returning full audit event with before/after snapshots - Implement exportAuditTimeline(filters, format) method generating PDF with timeline view, legal appendix, hash verification - Add company scoping to all queries and RBAC: All authenticated users can view timeline (company-filtered)
3. Backend: Abuse detection and unauthorized access monitoring (AC: #3) - Implement detectAbusePatterns(companyId, userId, timeWindow) method for repeated failed delete attempts, unauthorized access attempts, suspicious activity patterns - Implement getUnauthorizedAttempts(filters) method for 403 errors, blocked operations, deletion attempts - Implement notification system for abuse detection with in-app notifications to Chief Accountant/CFO - Create admin/audit view endpoint GET /api/v1/ap-audit/abuse requiring Chief Accountant/CFO/Admin permissions
4. Backend: DR backup and archive functionality (AC: #4) - Create APAuditBackup entity with fields: id, company_id, backup_date, archive_path, hash, record_count, status, created_by - Implement APAuditBackupService with createBackup(companyId) method exporting to compressed archive with SHA-256 hash - Implement scheduled weekly backup job using Spring @Scheduled annotation processing all companies - Implement listBackups(companyId) and downloadBackup(backupId) methods with permission verification
5. Backend: Cryptographic chain hashing and retention management (AC: #6) - Implement calculateChainHash(previousHash, currentEvent) method using SHA-256 hash of (previous_hash + current_event_hash) - Update audit log creation to include chain hash ensuring tamper detection - Implement retention policy enforcement with retention_until field and archival process for expired logs - Implement GDPR purge functionality with POST /api/v1/ap-audit/purge endpoint requiring Admin permission
6. Backend: AP audit controller and API (AC: #1-#6) - Create APAuditController with REST endpoints: GET /api/v1/ap-audit/timeline, GET /api/v1/ap-audit/events/{eventId}, GET /api/v1/ap-audit/timeline/export, GET /api/v1/ap-audit/abuse, GET /api/v1/ap-audit/backups, GET /api/v1/ap-audit/backups/{backupId}/download, POST /api/v1/ap-audit/purge - Support query params/filters: user, action, amount, supplier, attachment, outcome, startDate, endDate - Return proper HTTP status codes and add RBAC with controller delegating to service-level @PreAuthorize guards
7. Database: Flyway migrations for audit enhancements (AC: #1, #4, #6) - Create migration to add AP-specific indexes on audit_logs for efficient timeline queries - Create migration for APAuditBackup table with Company-scoped FK, backup_date, archive_path, hash, record_count, status checks - Create migration to add retention_until and chain_hash fields to audit_logs with default values
8. Frontend: AP audit timeline view component (AC: #2, #5) - Create APAuditTimeline page with chronological list of audit events, colored by action type - Display action type, user, timestamp, entity (bill/payment), summary with expandable event details - Add search and filter controls: user, action, amount, supplier, date range, outcome - Add action buttons: Export PDF, Refresh, Clear Filters with export dialog options
9. Frontend: AP audit abuse detection view (AC: #3) - Create APAuditAbuseView component displaying abuse patterns table and unauthorized attempts table - Add filters: user, date range, pattern type, severity and action buttons: Notify Admin, Export Report - Wire to /api/v1/ap-audit/abuse endpoint and display notifications when abuse patterns detected - Require Chief Accountant/CFO/Admin role to access
10. Frontend: DR backup management interface (AC: #4) - Create APAuditBackupList component displaying backup archives table with Backup Date, Archive Size, Hash, Record Count, Status, Actions - Add filters: date range, status and action buttons: Download, Verify Hash, Create Manual Backup - Wire to /api/v1/ap-audit/backups and download endpoints with backup creation status display - Require Chief Accountant/CFO/Admin role to access
11. Frontend: GDPR purge interface (AC: #6) - Create APAuditPurgeDialog component with purge scope selection: company-wide, user-specific, date range, entity-specific - Display preview of records to be purged with count and date range and require confirmation with warning message - Submit purge request requiring Admin role and display purge results: count of purged records, summary - Wire to /api/v1/ap-audit/purge endpoint
12. Testing: Unit and integration tests for audit functionality (AC: #1-#6) - Unit tests for APAuditService (timeline generation, filtering, abuse detection) - Unit tests for APAuditBackupService (backup creation, hash generation, archive compression) - Unit tests for cryptographic chain hashing (chain calculation, tamper detection) - Unit tests for retention policy (expired log detection, archival) - Integration tests for audit API endpoints (timeline, export, abuse, backups, purge) - Integration tests for scheduled backup job and RBAC filtering - Component tests for UI components - deferred to future sprint

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. Every bill/payment create, edit, post, approve, import, fail, delete-attempt produces detailed audit log (user, time, action, payload diff, hash)
2. Timeline view: colored by action type, exportable as PDF with legal appendix/hash
3. Unauthorized/deletion attempts/abuse visible in admin/audit view; notification for abuse/repeat blocked operations
4. DR plan: scheduled weekly backup/export of AP audits to external/secure/compressed archive
5. Reviewer filter/export: by user, action, amount, supplier, attachment, or outcome
6. All actions have cryptographic chain hash; 10+ years retention, GDPR purge on demand

docs.doc: Story 4.7: As an auditor or chief accountant, I want a complete, filterable history of every AP event and a disaster recovery (DR) plan, so that statutory and business compliance is bulletproof.

Objective: Complete audit log for all AP activities, timeline view, DR plan with scheduled backups, cryptographic chain hashing, 10+ years retention. Key services: APAuditService for logging, timeline views, DR backups.
FR48: Immutable Audit Trail - The audit trail must be append-only, stored in a separate table with referential integrity. NFR8: Audit Trail - Append-only, no modifications or deletions allowed.

Backend Location: controller/purchase/, Frontend Location: pages/PurchaseBills.tsx, Database Tables: purchase_bills, ap_payments. Multi-Tenancy Pattern: Row-level security through company-scoped architecture.

Design System: shadcn/ui (Tailwind + Radix primitives). DataTablePro: Server-side sorting/filtering/pagination, bulk selection, export CSV/Excel. Color system with semantic usage for errors, success, info states.
Comprehensive test design for Epic 4 with 113 test scenarios. P0 critical tests for audit trail, security, and data integrity. Risk assessment with unauthorized approval bypass and data loss risks.

Story 4.6 implemented comprehensive audit logging via AuditService for all VAT operations, PDF export with TT200-compliant formatting and hash generation, and SHA-256 hash generation for report integrity.

code.artifact: Existing audit logging interface requiring before/after JSON snapshots, SHA-256 diff hash, and IP/user-agent metadata for every bill lifecycle action.
Implementation builds audit records with eventType markers, assigns actor identity from SecurityContext, embeds before/after payloads, persists diff hashes, and reuses same pattern for payments.
Existing audit controller with pagination/filter plumbing, RBAC guards (ADMIN, CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT), and CSV export that logs downloads via auditService.logAuditExport.
Filter that enforces X-Company-Id header, validates numeric company IDs, falls back to authenticated user's company, and always clears thread-local after each request.
Existing audit page with TanStack Table grid, search inputs, entity/role filters, Refresh + Export buttons, and pagination controls fetching /admin/audit-logs with page/size parameters.
UX patterns including search term, filter chips, refresh + export handlers, PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS, and dual pagination stacks to replicate for APAudit tables.

dependencies.dependency: Spring Boot 3.5.7 stack with spring-boot-starter-web, data-jpa, data-redis, security, Flyway 11.10.0, PostgreSQL 42.7.4, JasperReports 6.21.3, DynamicReports 6.20.1, Apache POI 5.3.0, and jjwt 0.12.5 for REST APIs, caching, scheduled jobs, PDF/Excel exports, and JWT-secured RBAC.

React 19 + Vite 7, shadcn/Radix UI primitives, TanStack React Table 8.21.3, React Query 5.62.0, axios 1.7.9, lucide-react icons, date-fns, zod, and sonner toasts for APAudit timeline tables, filter forms, dialogs, and notifications.

constraints.constraint: Company context must be supplied via X-Company-Id or inferred from authenticated user, per CompanyContextFilter, so every APAudit endpoint and export job has to call CompanyContext.getCompanyId() before querying.

AuditLogController demonstrates that sensitive audit data is limited to ADMIN and CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT; APAudit controllers must extend this RBAC (with CFO) while still allowing read-only timeline access to company users where required.

AuditService already stores before/after JSON and diff hashes for bills/payments; any new APAudit ingestion must reuse the same pattern to avoid duplicating snapshot logic and ensure consistent signing.

Frontend data tables need search inputs, refresh buttons, record counts, page-size dropdowns (10/20/30/50/100), and pagination at the bottom to satisfy shared UX standards established by VATReportList & AuditLogPage.

Disaster-recovery archives and purge operations must log immutable trail entries via AuditService and obey 10+ year retention from Story 4.7, meaning background jobs can archive but never silently delete data.

interfaces.interface: Returns paged chronological events filtered by user, action, amountMin/Max, supplierId, attachment, outcome, startDate, endDate; response mirrors AuditLogPageResponse but limited to AP event types.
Fetches a single AP audit entry with before/after snapshots, diff hash, chain hash, and metadata for drill-down modals.
Streams PDF export for filtered timeline, embedding legal appendix + SHA-256 hash header similar to /admin/audit-logs/export.
Aggregates abuse detections and raw unauthorized attempts for abuse dashboard, with optional filters user, pattern, severity, startDate, endDate.
List backup metadata with pagination + filters status, startDate, endDate.
Streams secure archive, sets X-Content-SHA256, and logs download via AuditService.
Accepts JSON purge scope, performs GDPR purge/anonymization, emits immutable purge log entries, and returns purgedCount, archivedCount.

tests.standards: Follow Story 4.7 testing guidance + Epic 1-4 patterns: TestContainers-backed Spring Boot tests for service + controller layers, serialization checks similar to AuditServiceImplSerializationTest, scheduled job coverage, and Vitest/RTL for shadcn components (table filtering, dialogs, pagination).
tests.locations: Backend: backend/src/test/java/com/accounting/service/impl/AuditServiceImplSerializationTest.java for diff snapshots; extend this plus new ap sub-packages for APAuditService/BackupService. Frontend: Vitest suites under frontend/src/features/accounting/pages/APAudit/__tests__/ for timeline table, abuse view, backup list, purge dialog.
tests.ideas: - AC1: integration test verifying logPurchaseBillEvent/logPaymentEvent emit chain hashes and company-scoped entries, plus API timeline fetch returns them sorted. - AC2: PDF export test confirming color-coded timeline metadata + SHA-256 header with legal appendix. - AC3: abuse detection unit tests injecting repeated delete attempts + unauthorized logs to ensure notifications fire and /ap-audit/abuse responds with severities. - AC4: scheduler test using @SpringBootTest clock control to ensure weekly backup job processes companies, uploads archives, records metadata/hash. - AC5: controller test covering filter combinations and verifying pagination metadata. - AC6: retention + purge tests simulating expired records and GDPR purge scope, checking immutable purge audit entries. - Frontend: timeline table search/pagination snapshot test, abuse table severity badge rendering, backup list hash verification flow, purge dialog confirmation gating.
